bio: Belmor is no Dwarf of Stoneloom. He emerged from the deepest tunnels a few years back, claiming to be an ambassador from even deeper – a city of Dwarves who had never seen the surface. Despite this mystery, he answers few questions about his people… but he does not hesitate to defend Stoneloom.
